cards.name: hero
cards.question: LinkedIn Text Formatter
cards.qualifier: Write your LinkedIn post, style selected words, add bullet or numbered lists, and see roughly where the feed will cut it off with "…more" before you copy it over.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to format a LinkedIn post

steps.title: Write or paste your draft
steps.text: Start in the editor with plain text.

steps.title: Select and style
steps.text: Highlight a word or short phrase and choose a style.

steps.title: Check the preview, then copy
steps.text: Look at what sits above the "…more" marker.

cards.name: key-point
cards.quote: LinkedIn's composer doesn't offer bold, italic or list buttons for regular posts at the time of writing.
